findings.finding: Use recursion: f(2^k)=P(2^k)*f(2^{k-1})^2, where P(m)=(m)!/(2^{m/2}(m/2)!). So N=f(2^{20})=∏_{i=1}^{20}P(2^i)^{2^{20-i}}. P(2^i) is odd ⇒ v₂(N)=0. Compute v₅(N)>0, so 10‑adic exponent k=min(v₂,v₅)=0. Answer 0.
Key: tournament outcomes ↔ binary strings of length 20 → each leaf unique → N = (2²⁰)!. So k = v₅((2²⁰)!)=⌊2²⁰/5⌋+⌊2²⁰/25⌋+…=262 140. Answer = 262 140 mod 10⁵=62140. Pitfall: assume ties; none exist.
